rules.description: Expire untagged images after 7 days. Every push replaces the `latest` tag, which leaves the previous image untagged but still billed; nothing can deploy an untagged image, so keeping them past a week only pays for storage.
Keep the 20 most recent SHA-tagged images. deploy.sh rolls back by pinning TAG to a previous short SHA, so this is the depth of the rollback window — roughly a month of deploys.
